banned.why: every random number comes from a seed: Rng / deriveSeed (@futuremagic/core)
one renderer, made in one place (createRenderer)
workers are created by the one worker pool
every material is a kind in the registry, so warm-up knows every shader (docs/SHADERS.md)
shader variants come from the registry's TSL kinds, not from patched source (docs/SHADERS.md)
compiling is the Stage's job: warmUp(), warmLater() and add() (docs/SHADERS.md)
lights are a fixed pool made before the warm-up: the light count is part of every shader's cache key (docs/SHADERS.md)
every LLM call goes through src/llm (model roster, task routing, usage tracking)

layers.why: the society simulation is pure data: it runs in a worker and in headless tests, and takes the town only through the PlaceGraph (the planner depends on the sim, never the reverse)
the town planner is pure data: it runs in workers and headless tests (it fills the sim's PlaceGraph type, with the sim's per-kind defaults from placeKinds)
2D geometry is a leaf: everything pure may use it
mesh data is built in workers from the plan: plain typed arrays, no three.js (src/render turns them into meshes)
world queries are pure: gameplay, workers and tests use them
the procedural text engine is pure: workers, tests and tools use it
the LLM layer knows prompts and contracts, not the screen
the renderer does not know about the game, the UI or the LLM
